[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Move Zeroes** [LC 283 · Move Zeroes](https://leetcode.com/problems/move-zeroes/){difficulty="Easy"}

Treat the non-zero values as the survivors of a filter and compact them to the front with a write pointer; then paint `0` over the leftover tail. That is the read/write template with `keep = (x != 0)`.
